records.title: Green Hydrogen powered ships
details: a to e): (ii) Deendayal Port Authority (DPA), V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority (VOCPA), and Paradip Port Authority (PPA) have been identified as hydrogen hubs. The Green Hydrogen Hub Development Roadmap outlines a phased strategy to establish these major ports as key centers for green hydrogen production and export. VOCPA has prepared a Detailed Project Report for a pilot project involving the development of a bunkering and refueling facility with a 750 cubic metre green methanol capacity.

details: (e): Under the 15th Finance Commission, the targets for establishment of MRUs have already been achieved.
